commit.message:
LU-20296 tests: pick a new connection during ctx nego timeout

New sanity-krb5/test_202 sub-test is intended to verify that
alternate connections will be tried if a timeout occurs during
security context negotiation, mainly after a target failover.

It should only succeed if patch for Gerrit
https://review.whamcloud.com/c/fs/lustre-release/+/66081
("66081: LU-20296 gss: also force reconnect if ctx nego timeout")
has been merged and fail otherwise.
